package: @astryxdesign/lab

# LineClamp

Wrap any children (mixed inline content, nested elements) to clamp the whole block to N lines. Reuses useTruncation for overflow detection.

**Import:** `import {LineClamp} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Use for clamping a block of mixed/composed content, not a single Text node.
- **Do:** Use Text's own maxLines for a single Text node instead.
- **Do:** Disable tooltip when content is reachable elsewhere, to avoid redundant announcement.
- **Do:** Inert only for a focusable in the clamp's own flow whose box lies wholly past the last visible line (a positioned element placed against an in-flow containing block in the clamp, like a control's own wrapper, is in the flow and judged by that block's box); never inside a fixed, escaping absolute, top-layer or portaled subtree; a partly visible control stays reachable; a focusable with no box counts as past the last line until it gains a box; re-checked on size, content and font changes. Gap: an absolutely placed control the clamp clips stays a tab stop. Never the focused element, never your own tabIndex or aria-hidden.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Content to clamp. Composable version of maxLines — wraps arbitrary children. **(required)** |
| `maxLines` | `number` | - | Max lines before clamping with ellipsis. **(required)** |
| `hasTruncateTooltip` | `boolean` | `true` | Tooltip with full text on hover or focus when clamped. Clamped root is focusable. Follows Text's prop name. |
| `truncateTooltipPlacement` | `'above' \| 'below' \| 'start' \| 'end'` | `'above'` | Tooltip placement. Default 'above'. |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'span' \| 'p'` | `'div'` | HTML element to render. Default 'div'. |
